findings: Exact installed module byte digest, original function globals/name/first-line and code identity gate current-thread tracing; an existing tracer or changed source causes original forwarding with incomplete capture.

CallObserver invokes the original once with unchanged arguments/deadline and returns the same result or original exception. Finally restores the prior trace; trace/projection failures only mark capture incomplete.

Trace records only exact original completion-frame line/return/exception IDs and directly called reviewed helper boolean returns. It records return-statement groups separately from CPython cleanup return-event lines. A grouped return is not a unique root-cause finding.

Projection reads exact built-in dictionaries and accepts only bounded lowercase64hex digests, bounded exact integers, exact booleans and fixed action words. It does not retain command, path, payload, arbitrary repr, custom equality or mapping values.

NativeReturns forwards the actual native method once and captures only pre-existing snapshot kwargs and returned edge scalar identities. It neither invokes native work again nor adds authority helpers.
Private child wrapping retains original fixture completion observer and original daemon entrypoint; one exact spawn substitutes only the diagnostic child path and adds a private output env field.

Trace export occurs after original fixture cleanup and patch retirement. Closed schema rejects extra/duplicate fields, excessive calls/events and unsupported scalar values. Original attempt failure and cleanup failure remain distinct from diagnostic completeness.

All20 declared source controls are meaningful by inspection, including real-store/modeled-edge refusal groups, argument/exception forwarding, prior trace/refusal, bound limits, export privacy and cleanup failure distinction. Owner execution evidence is separate.
limits: No tests, installed workload or interpreter admission executed by this peer.
Source tracing and scalar capture consume real time; unchanged deadline does not make this latency qualification.
Call/group observations identify the executed refusal group; absent internal boolean details cannot establish a unique guard cause.
The original Codex continuation failure remains a failure even if this diagnostic captures it completely.
Operational workflow/input admission and exact installed wheel bindings require their separate peer.
